Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Under the Income Tax Law 2009 a person's monthly income is taxed at 0% to AFN 5,000, 2% to 12,500, 10% plus AFN 150 to 100,000 and 20% plus AFN 8,900 above.
figures.applies: Law as published in 2009; whether it is applied unchanged in 2026 (including the Revenue Department's July 2026 reduction guidelines reported in the press) was not confirmed from a primary source.

sources.said: (3) The income tax of natural persons shall be the amount calculated in accordance with the following schedule: From Afs.0 to Afs.5,000 monthly 0% From Afs.5,001 to Afs.12,500 2% From Afs. 12,501 to Afs. 100,000 10% + Afs. 150 fixed amount From Afs. 100,000 and above 20% + Afs.8,900 fixed amount.

figures.finding: The tax year is the solar year, from 1 Hamal (21 March) to the last day of Hoot (20 March).

sources.said: The tax year is the solar (Hejiri Shamsi) year which starts on the first day of Hamal (21 March) and ends on the last day of Hoot (20 March) of that year.

figures.finding: A non-resident engaged in services or business in Afghanistan is taxed on Afghan-source income; one not in business is taxed on interest, dividends, rents, royalties and other Afghan-source income.
figures.applies: Income Tax Law 2009 arts 7-8; the rate on a performer's fee was not found.

sources.said: Non-resident natural and legal persons engaged in economic, service or business activities in Afghanistan shall be subject to tax on their income from sources within Afghanistan.

figures.finding: Every employer withholds income tax from salaries and wages at the monthly schedule of Article 4 and remits it within 10 days after the month's end; a person paying a contractor withholds 7% of the gross (a fixed tax in lieu of income tax) where the contractor has no business licence, or 2% (creditable) where it has one, and legal persons withhold 20% from royalties, prizes, bonuses and service charges.
figures.applies: Income Tax Law 2009 (Official Gazette No. 976), as translated in August 2009; amendments since, including the Revenue Department's guidelines of 14 July 2026, not read (see the residents blocker).

sources.said: Article 58 Withholding and payment of tax All natural or legal profit and non profit … Article 60 Remittance of tax payments Any employer required to withhold tax under Article 58 of this Law shall remit to the State the amount withheld not later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the amounts were withheld. … shall be subject to 7 percent fixed tax in lieu of income tax. This tax is withheld from the gross amount payable to the contractor. (2) Persons who have a business license and provide the services and other activities mentioned in paragraph (1) of this Article to the specified entities shall be subject to 2 percent contractor tax. … 2. twenty percent tax from interest, dividends, royalties, prizes, rewards, lotteries, bakhshishis (gratuities), bonuses, and service charges according to the provisions of this Law.

figures.finding: A non-resident who provides entertainment in Afghanistan (theatre, films, radio, television, music) pays a fixed tax of 10% of ticket and admission receipts in lieu of income tax and business receipts tax; a non-resident hired for a fee (no tickets) falls under the general rules: tax on Afghan-source income, with the 7% (unlicensed) or 2% contractor withholding on services under contract.
figures.applies: Income Tax Law 2009, arts. 8, 72, 73, as translated in August 2009; later amendments not read.

sources.said: Article 73 Fixed tax of exhibition income (1) Fixed tax shall be applied to natural persons who are residents of Afghanistan and to natural and legal persons who are non-residents of Afghanistan. (2) Persons mentioned in paragraph (1) of this Article who provide entertainment such as theatre, exhibition of films, radio, television, music, or sports competition in Afghanistan shall be subject to a fixed tax of ten … percent of receipts from sale of admission or tickets. The fixed tax shall be imposed in lieu of income tax and business receipts tax.

figures.finding: Authors get no special rate: royalties paid by a legal person bear the 20% withholding of Article 46, and royalties from Afghan sources are income of a non-resident too.
figures.applies: Income Tax Law 2009, arts. 7 and 46, as translated in August 2009; later amendments not read.

sources.said: Article 46 Withholding tax (1) Profit or non-profit legal persons formed under the laws of Afghanistan shall be required to withhold income tax as follows: … 2. twenty percent tax from interest, dividends, royalties, prizes, rewards, lotteries, bakhshishis (gratuities), bonuses, and service charges according to the provisions of this Law.
